QuestInfo.0: JM From tha Streetz has a job for you.
QuestInfo.1: JM gave you a simple task. Go to the #bpharmacy#k, take the item from the drawer, and bring it back to him. #rThe item he wants is in the rightmost drawer on the second row from the top.#k
QuestInfo.2: You delievered the item to JM. It was an Emergency Kit... Was someone hurt?

yes.0: Hmm... I don't know you. You any good? Let's see how you handle a simple job to start with. Check the #brightmost drawer on the second row from the top in the Pharmacy#k. Bring me whatever's inside. Simple, right?

no.0: This is the big city, kid! You gotta work to eat! Don't you know that?

yes.0: Yeah, you'll do just fine here. I'll call you when I got work, so be ready. And here, wear this. The stuff you got on now is way too ghetto.

item.0: You get it yet? It's in the #brightmost drawer, second from the top in the Pharmacy#k.
